name: Hydroxypethidine
summary: Hydroxypethidine (Bemidone) is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of the more commonly used pethidine (meperidine).5x meperidine in potency, and it also has NMDA antagonist properties like its close relative ketobemidone.

pharmacology.text: Hydroxypethidine is slightly more potent than meperidine as an analgesic, 1.5x meperidine in potency, and it also has NMDA antagonist properties like its close relative ketobemidone.

uses.text: Hydroxypethidine (Bemidone) is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of the more commonly used pethidine (meperidine).

sideEffects.text: Side effects can include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression which can be life-threatening.
